findings.current: It seems he’s on his way to attend a luncheon with the City Lord.
findings.defect: The English presents Taekyung as still traveling, while the source says he apparently went to attend the luncheon; the next sentence allows that he may already have arrived.
findings.rationale: 간 모양일세 describes his having gone for that purpose, not necessarily being currently en route.
findings.replacement: It seems he went to attend a luncheon with the City Lord.

findings.current: the Red Wind Band would have run so fast they’d have left their pants behind.
findings.defect: This converts the slang idiom 빤쓰런 into a literal pants-based image and adds unsupported emphasis on running speed.
findings.rationale: 빤쓰런 functions as crude slang for hastily fleeing; it does not mean literally outrunning or leaving one’s pants behind.
findings.replacement: the Red Wind Band would have turned tail and fled long ago.

findings.current: I heard Cheongpung ask brightly as he walked along with a light step.
findings.defect: The English removes the fact that Cheongpung directs the question to Taekyung.
findings.rationale: 내게 explicitly marks Taekyung as the person being asked.
findings.replacement: Cheongpung, walking with a light step, asked me brightly.

findings.current: a long table like the ones I had only seen in movies set in magic schools
findings.defect: The table’s specified physical quality changes from broad or spacious to long.
findings.rationale: 넓은 describes breadth or spacious size, not specifically length.
findings.replacement: a vast table like the ones I had only seen in movies set in magic schools

findings.current: What a strikingly handsome young man, just as one would expect of a young prodigy of the martial world.
findings.defect: The description omits that Taekyung is tall or has an imposing, well-proportioned stature.
findings.rationale: 훤칠한 conveys notable height and a fine, well-proportioned appearance, not merely handsomeness.
findings.replacement: What a tall, strikingly handsome young man, just as one would expect of a young prodigy of the martial world.

findings.current: He doesn’t particularly look as impressive as the rumors claim…
findings.defect: The English generalizes the judgment to Taekyung’s overall appearance, whereas the speaker specifically doubts that his skill is as formidable as rumored.
findings.rationale: 실력이 대단해 보이지는 않는데 explicitly makes his ability or skill the object of the assessment.
findings.replacement: His skills don’t look quite as impressive as the rumors claim…

summary: The chapter is broadly faithful, with several minor losses or shifts in action, physical detail, and characterization.
